column1: # bash-allowlist.tsv -- factory-owned DATA, read by guard-dangerous.sh on every Bash call. Never executed.
# Default deny: a Bash command runs only if it passes the character gate and matches an ACTIVE row for
# the acting identity. This table is the proposed Bash column of the authority matrix (amendment B1,
# proposed, not applied). Changing it is a constitutional amendment: factory-engineer prepares, human ratifies.
# Columns (TAB-separated): IDENTITY  STATUS  MODE  PROV  SPEC  JUSTIFICATION
#   IDENTITY  agent name, ORCHESTRATOR, or @GROUP (a group row; identities include it with SPEC = @GROUP)
#   STATUS    active | inactive:<reason>   (inactive rows never match; they exist so the decision is visible)
#   MODE      allow (hook returns no decision; settings.json decides) | ask (hook returns permissionDecision ask)
#   PROV      -        no repository script is executed
#             hook     factory hook script (must be a regular file, not a symlink); see guard header
#             git      program token must be tracked and unmodified versus HEAD, else deny
#             git-ask  as git, but return ask instead of deny (dataset-engineer's own scripts)
#             git+args as git, and every PATH argument (manifests) must also be tracked and unmodified
#   SPEC      space-separated items, matched left to right, no backtracking:
#             word       exact token          ?word   optional exact token
#             <C>        one token of class C (also <C>? <C>* <C>+; <C:arg> passes an argument)
#             {a;b;...}  option set, any order, each alternative at most once; alternatives:
#                        --x  exact | --x=<C>  joined value | --x:<C>  separate value | --x:<C>+  1..n values
#                        a leading ! makes the option required
#   Classes: PATH[:prefix] REV REVX(REV or REV:PATH) INT SHA40 SHA256 REGION AWSID IMGID OUT RO
#            SBT:<project> SBTTEST DSSCRIPT ENV ENVNP TFCHDIR TFPLAN STACK EC2FILTER S3PREFIX
#            (definitions in guard-dangerous.sh; REGION is pinned to us-east-1, amendment FE-P6-06)
# Directives: @projects = sbt project ids (spec Phase 2 list); @env / @env-nonprod = ratified environment
# names. Both environment lists hold dev (amendment FE-P6-06); inactive rows still never match.
